steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Hm... according to the map, this should be the street market.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Wow, there's so many stalls, way more than I imagined... Uh oh, I'm starting to worry maybe I didn't bring enough money.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Wow, crystal dumplings! And lotus seed buns! So much tasty food... I'll buy some just to try, they can't cost that much, right?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Om nom... Burp! I'm so full!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh no! I can't eat anymore! I came to buy gifts for everybody!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Sigh, this is all my fault. I got mad at Cardi when she stepped on my backpack...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I didn't mean to, but my backpack...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I finally made friends with everybody, I can't let it stay like this!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I'll pick a good present, and then apologize to Cardi!

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: The luster, the pattern, the weight...

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: No mistaking it, we're gonna be rich this time!

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: Hmph. That Columbian lady just looked at us funny.

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: Don't be so haughty! If you don't look after your stuff, somebody else will look after it for you!

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: Damn, daai goh. Barely three words and you scammed that right up...

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: That bitch has no clue what just happened to her!

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: That wasn't no scam, dumbass, I asked permission.

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: We do what we've gotta do to feed ourselves. Is it so wrong to ask Heaven for permission to snatch something?

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: Wow, you're right! But...

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: What is it, kiddo? Out with it!

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: I kinda wanna touch that pendant...

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: Here! Over by the window, in the sunlight, the patterns really stand out!

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: Wowza, this foreign stuff is way different from what we get in Lungmen.

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: Hm? This part... is it supposed to be some kind of beast? There's something on its back—
The young man's hand slips and the pendant drops out the window.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Excuse me! I want one of these and one of those!

steps.name: Street Stall Owner
steps.text: Alright, alright, girl, let me wrap them up for you.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I don't need a bag, I can put them right into my backpack!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh, I need to pay though... Um, my wallet should be in my jacket pocket.
The pendant falls into Cuora's open backpack without anyone noticing.

steps.name: Street Stall Owner
steps.text: You don't look like a Lungmenite. Are you here on vacation? Let me give you a discount! Here's your change.

steps.name: Street Stall Owner
steps.text: You're buying a lot. Is it for your parents?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: No, for my friends!

steps.name: Street Stall Owner
steps.text: The girl here has a lot of friends, huh? Here, take some freebies.

steps.name: Street Stall Owner
steps.text: It's all the best Lungmen has to offer, handmade. Share with your friends!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Thank you, mister!

steps.name: Street Stall Owner
steps.text: Don't mention it! I hope you have fun in Lungmen. And uh, keep an eye on your things...

steps.name: Street Stall Owner
steps.text: There've been a lot of pickpockets around here lately. They especially like targeting foreigners.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Got it! Now I know I may not look it, but I'm really good at fighting!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: If I see a pickpocket, I'll send him flying!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I never knew the Lungmenites were so friendly! That guy gave me a ton of stuff...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I'll pick through it all when I get back and hand stuff out to everyone at Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Those little animal figures would be perfect for Adnachiel and Steward...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: And that Yanese silk cap would be great for May!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: The music box would be good for Lava, and the scarf for Instructor Dobermann...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Sigh, but after going all over the place, I still don't have anything for Cardi.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: What can I give her?

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: Wait a second there, girl!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Huh? What's wrong?

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: I dropped something out the window and it landed in that souvenir stall over there. A metal pendant, did you happen to see it?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Hm? No, I didn't.

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: I did. It fell right into your backpack. Would you mind opening it for me so I can take a look?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Just a sec, I'll check...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: All the little souvenirs that guy gave me are metal thingies... You didn't come over to bother me just because you saw all that, did you?

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: How dare you!

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: Gimme that bag, I'll find it!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Hand's off! Don't touch my backpack!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Hmph! You're trying to steal from me? You'll have to ask my baseball bat first!
Half an hour later...

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: Hmm, yeah.

steps.name: Careless Youth
steps.text: Good idea, ah goh, I'll start putting it together!

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: Don't mess it up this time!

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: Dammit, that little dumbass is short on success and long on failure.

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: I can't believe a little girl like that put him on the ground in just a couple of moves.

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: If you can't use your fists, you gotta use your brain. Let's change it up.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: It's just like the souvenir shop guy said... do I look like such a clueless tourist?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I guess Lungmen's got a real problem with crime and safety...

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: You there, girl, hold up a second!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Who are you?

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: Hey, don't get the wrong idea. I just heard you talking about how Lungmen isn't safe, so I figured I'd ask what's up.

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: Here's my badge, these blocks are my beat here.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Lungmen... Block Manager? What do you do?

steps.name: Shrewd Youth
steps.text: (I've got all kinds of stuff like this prepped and ready. Another badge, another bit of insurance. Let's try this one on for size.)

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: I keep order on the streets and help out the residents.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: Did you encounter something that upset you?

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: We've gotten some reports around here of street vendors selling counterfeit goods to tourists at jacked up prices. I'm undercover investigating.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: If anything like that happened to you, I might be able to help.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Well... The vendor guy over there was actually really nice. He gave me a discount and a whole bunch of freebies, actually...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I mean, I bought a whole bunch of stuff, and I don't feel like I spent that much. Definitely feels cheaper than back in Columbia...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh, but there was this guy back there who tried to steal my stuff!

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: Oh? Could you describe his appearance, what he was wearing maybe?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Uh... he was a man, taller than me, and well... um, I don't really remember what he looked like...

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: That's not much to go on. I don't think I'd be able to find him with just this.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Never mind. I need to focus on getting a gift for Cardi anyway. Thanks for the offer, Mr. Block Manager. I'd better get going.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: You need to buy something for your friend? What kind of thing are you looking for?

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: I've been working these blocks for years. Maybe I can point you in the right direction.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: I'm not sure how it is in other countries, but us Lungmen Block Managers, we work hard to help our citizens solve problems!

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: After all, as a Lungmen public servant, I can't let a foreigner leave with the impression that this city isn't safe.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: If you've got anything troubling you, ma'am, just let me know.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh, okay...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Well, you see... I got into sort of a fight with a friend, and I want to get her an apology gift...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: But I've been all over the place, and I still haven't found the right gift.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: It's not like I haven't bought anything, it's just nothing I've bought feels right.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: When you're giving your friend a gift, it's the thought that counts, right?

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: I've got a short temper and I blow up on my friends sometimes, but when it comes down to it, we're always cool after sharing a meal, a drink, and an apology.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: So, did you apologize to that friend of yours yet?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Not yet... I mean, it's really hard to know how and when to start.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: Do you know the kinds of things she likes?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Umm... what does Cardi like?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I think I remember Adnachiel saying that Cardi wants to be a skier.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: And I saw some ski clothes gathering dust in her room...

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: Then you should get her a gift a skier would like, right?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Um... but I don't know anything about skiing.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: Hah, yeah, I get the impression you're more into baseball.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: Do you play? Or just watch?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I play! I love baseball!

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: Then why not get her a baseball gift? If it's something you like, that makes a good gift too.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Um... but I don't think Cardi is into baseball.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I put together a game on the Rhodes Island deck before, but she didn't show...

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: Yeah, speaking of baseball, I just remembered the mall on that block over there has some sort of game where you win prizes playing baseball. Want to check it out?

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: If you can't think of what to get her, you can just give her whatever prize you win.

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: A gift won by your own effort has more meaning to it than something you bought, right?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: That makes sense. Lava did say that handmade gifts are better, but I don't have much talent for crafts...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Baseball is what I'm best at, so a prize won in baseball should be good.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Let's take a look! It's been a while since I played, and it'll be a nice chance to have some fun!

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: The games are over there. Looks like it's pretty quiet, so head on over!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: You mean the place with the funny machine?

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Step right up, swing the bat, hit the ball, and win a prize! Today's the last day, hurry on over!

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: (Ugh, that idiot's dressed up as an arcade worker. Looks convincing enough.)

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: (Making use of this arcade that just closed, getting the girl to take the bait, it's almost too easy... I really am a genius!)

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Hi there! Is this the place where you play baseball? What are your prizes?

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Oh, uh... prizes, yeah...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Wow! All that stuff behind the glass there? That's all the prizes?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: How about that one! Can I get the snowboard?

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: You want the snowboard? Well, that's the grand prize. Pretty tough to win that one...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Hmm, why do I feel like this guy is kinda familiar...?

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Miss, I gotta warn you, no matter how much you saddle up to me, I'm not gonna make the challenge easier for you.

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: See that pitching machine? When you hit the ball back, the scoreboard there will rate you based on where the ball hits.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: So, if I hit the red center, I get the grand prize?

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: It's not that simple! You pay 40 Lungmen Dollars for a round, you get ten balls per round, and if your score is over 475, you get the grand prize.

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Wanna try?

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: 475 points means hitting the red center five times, isn't that a bit too hard? Are the other prizes easier to get?

steps.name: Block Manager?
steps.text: (What are you doing, why are you making it so hard? Nobody would take a challenge that tough. She'll give up after she fails once!)

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Sure, we encourage everyone to try a whole lot.

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: If you score less than 475, the threshold for the grand prize goes down a bit, to a minimum of 200.

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: (How good could the girl be? This'll definitely buy enough time.)

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Hmmm... Cardi will probably like that snowboard, huh?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Now that I think about it, I really wanna see Cardi on the snow!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Okay, let's give it a try, I'll get it in one go. Bring it on!

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Let's take your entry fee first, and we'll keep your bag for you in the cabinet back there.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: It's true about Lungmen! We've been walking for ages and only covered two blocks. My feet are dying!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: That's because you keep pulling us into every store, and spend hours picking and choosing without ever actually buying anything.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: That's because my wallet is already basically empty!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Yeah, I remember seeing that baseball glove and bat you ordered a couple of days ago.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Those are apology gifts for Cuora! And I had to sell some old stuff to make up what I was short...

steps.name: May
steps.text: Oh? Have you and Cuora not yet reconciled?

steps.name: May
steps.text: I remember you two quarreling something fierce in the game room... First time I've ever seen Cuora bite a person.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Thinking back on it... it was my fault.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: I can just be too carefree sometimes, assuming everyone's always out to have fun with each other, no joke that can't be made...

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: The medic operators say Cuora's obsession with protecting her backpack is subconscious. Since she's forgotten most of her past, no one knows exactly where it comes from...

steps.name: May
steps.text: She's even forgotten her family and friends... Pretty sad, when you think about it.

steps.name: May
steps.text: But she told me that after making friends at Rhodes Island, she doesn't feel so lonely anymore.

steps.name: May
steps.text: By the way, I haven't seen her since early this morning. Where's she gone off to?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Sigh... she's probably still avoiding me...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Ha-yah!

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Wh... what? You hit the red zone again? How are you that lucky?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: You hit it again?!

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: No... is the difficulty set too low? I think I can adjust the ball direction and blocks here...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Again!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Wow! So you can throw out balls that change direction, and put up some more blocks... Hah, alright, I'll get serious too.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Phew! I feel fantastic. This is the joy of baseball!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Got some more balls? Send them my way!

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Is... is this really happening?

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: I maxed out the difficulty!

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Her stance, her strength, her precision...

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Is this girl Ambrois Edwards?!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Hey, how many points did I get? Did I win the prize?

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Um... the scoring system is overloaded or something, but just looking at it, you definitely cleared 475...

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: (Shit! Daai goh just left, he can't have found the pendant yet... What do I do? I have to buy him some more time.)

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Then let me get that snowboard!

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: Err, okay... No, wait! I think you're not quite satisfied yet, miss. Would you like to hit a few more balls?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: But I already won the prize... I guess I do want to play some more. Do I have to pay?

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: No, you got the prize, and since nobody else is around, you can keep playing until we close!
The ball flies toward Cuora, and in the split second before it passes through the corner of her vision, she swings her bat forcefully—
To the sight of the 'arcade worker' the girl's figure seems to overlap with all the baseball stars he's ever seen.
The ball once again nails the center zone. At which point the pitching machine malfunctions, emitting sparks and giving off an uncomfortable sound.

steps.name: Arcade Worker?
steps.text: What... what's happening?
BOOM—

steps.name: May
steps.text: Good heavens! I heard that explosion just now, I'm sure we're getting caught up in another incident here now...

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Sounds like it came from that mall over there. Say, what's that on the ground...?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: That's Cuora's backpack!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Oh no... is Cuora in danger?!

steps.name: May
steps.text: Over here! Cuora's here!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Cuora! Cuora!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: She's fine, just looks like she's sleeping. Oh? What's that she's holding...?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: It's a... snowboard?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Where... am I? Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I remember... I was playing baseball, and then there was a boom...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: What happened next...? Where'd those two guys go?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I was having so much fun, I didn't get a chance to thank them...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: But hey, I think Lungmenites are really friendly!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh! Yeah! My prize! Where's the snowboard I got for Cardi?!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Phew, it's not broken.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: And my gifts for the others, they're all still here.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Come in!

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Oh, Cardi...

steps.name: Cardigan and Cuora
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: You first, Cuora.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Um, okay! This snowboard I won at the mall.. it's for you! I'm sorry about that thing before!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: So the snowboard was for me...?

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: I heard some of the others say you wanted to be a skier...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: And I remembered you had some ski clothes, so I thought...

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Oh, those clothes...

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Heh, well, I kinda ran into a little financial trouble last month and, well... I sold them...

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Well, I can get you some new ski clothes next time. Or is there something else you want?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Hmmm... let me think.

steps.name: Cuora
steps.text: Sure! Just say the word!
Cardigan offers a new baseball bat to Cuora, then raises her other hand, waving it in front of the girl.
It is covered by a baseball glove.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Alright... I want you to teach me to play baseball! Starting today!
